reference.title: Checks and rule IDs
reference.shortdesc: Every check a draft passes, what it stops, and whether it fails the draft or only warns.

row.entry: Missing fields, wrong types, keys, sources, notes or conflicts that don't exist, too many or too few rows
XML that isn't valid against the OASIS DITA 1.3 RELAX NG grammar
A topic with no short description
A topic with no licence notice
A number typed into a specification table instead of a key reference
A number with a hardware unit typed into prose
A draft that doesn't record its run, schema and model
A table header that differs from the header every sibling uses
A short description longer than 300 characters
A draft comment with no disposition
A key that isn't defined for the generation, or a key from a source the paragraph doesn't cite
A number with no matching fact, or the right number in the wrong unit, such as GB for GiB
A flag, command or pattern that no fact contains
A merge while any draft comment is open

section.title: Results
section.p: Revise: the model revises only the failed fields, up to times, then the field becomes a question. Withhold: the topic doesn't reach a writer. Fail: the rule fails the gate. Warn: the rule is reported and doesn't fail.
